validation.evidence: The same beta key accepted by GET /api/v1/chatbots/<app-A>/info initialized API MCP and returned the private B dataset ID and name from tools/list and ragflow_list_datasets. A was configured with only dataset A. No owner session/API credential was provided to the beta requests. An invalid or absent key returned application code 102; beta on ordinary GET /datasets/<B> returned HTTP 401. The normal Nginx MCP request returned HTTP 404.
validation.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: Actual document-text retrieval through MCP was attempted twice and returned isError:true: the configured local embedding endpoint refused the connection. Thus MCP metadata disclosure/scope escalation is dynamically confirmed; successful text retrieval is not. Direct API tests were inside the container and bypassed Nginx; the lab gateway blocks this MCP path.
